prompt_record.text:
Use the attached accepted artwork as the STYLE reference. Create a workflow-repair conceptual illustration with the same graphite hand-drawn outlines, soft flat ivory colour, faint paper grain, muted cyan and desaturated rose accents, restrained amber light, raised front three-quarter view and plain warm-grey background.
Subject: a standing rectangular frame contains a small simple woven fabric swatch with a stitched seam. Beside it, a separate small round magnified study shows just a close-up of that same seam; the surrounding fabric in the main frame remains visually continuous. A faint plain connector line identifies the small inspected area. This is a local repair concept, not a comparison of bad versus good results and not a screenshot of a functioning brush tool. No paintbrush, cursor, selection handles, controls, checkmarks or success badge.
4:3 landscape. Subject compact, centred slightly above middle; bottom third quiet and empty for a real HTML caption. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark or people.
